endorsements.name: Roberto Piña
endorsements.label: CVE-2020-37037
endorsements.description: Avast SecureLine 5.5.522.0 contains an unquoted service path vulnerability that allows local users to potentially execute code with elevated system privileges. Attackers can exploit the unquoted path in the service configuration to inject malicious code that would execute with LocalSystem account permissions during service startup.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: HIGH (CVSS 4.0, 8.5)

endorsements.name: Roberto Piña
endorsements.label: CVE-2020-37064
endorsements.description: EPSON EasyMP Network Projection 2.81 contains an unquoted service path vulnerability in the EMP_NSWLSV service that allows local users to potentially execute arbitrary code. Attackers can exploit the unquoted path in C:\Program Files (x86)\EPSON Projector\EasyMP Network Projection V2\ to inject malicious code that would execute with LocalSystem privileges.
